ebra veartsekha baderekh baderekh elekh lo asur yamin usmovl
okhel bakesef tashbireni veakhalti umayim bakesef titen li veshatiti rak ebra veragla

velo ava sikhon melekh kheshbon haavirenu bo ki hiksha yehva elohekha et rukho veimets et levavo lemaan tito veyadkha kaom haze

vayitnehu yehva elohenu lefanenu vanakh oto veet vnv banav veet kal amo

rak habhema bazaznu lanu ushlal hearim asher lakhadnu
mearoer asher al sefat nakhal arnon vehair asher banakhal vead hagilad lo hayta kirya asher sagva mimenu et hakol natan yehva elohenu lefanenu
rak el erets bene amon lo karavta kal yad nakhal yabok veare hahar vekhol asher tsiva yehva elohenu
vanefen vanaal derekh habashan vayetse og melekh habashan likratenu hu vekhal amo lamilkhama edrei
vayomer yehva ela al tira oto ki veyadkha natati oto veet kal amo veet artso veasita lo kaasher asita lesikhon melekh haemori asher yoshev bekheshbon
vayiten yehva elohenu beyadenu gam et og melekh habashan veet kal amo vanakehu ad bilti hishir lo sarid
vanilkod et kal arav baet hahiv lo hayta kirya asher lo lakakhnu meitam shishim ir kal khevel argov mamlekhet og babashan
kal ele arim betsurot khoma gevoha delatayim uvriakh levad meare haprazi harbe meod
vanakharem otam kaasher asinu lesikhon melekh kheshbon hakharem kal ir metim hanashim vehataf
vekhal habhema ushlal hearim bazonu lanu
vanikakh baet hahiv et haarets miyad shene malkhe haemori asher beever hayarden minakhal arnon ad har khermon
tsidonim yikru lekhermon siryon vehaemori yikru lo senir
kol are hamishor vekhal hagilad vekhal habashan ad salkha veedrei are mamlekhet og babashan
ki rak og melekh habashan nishar miyeter harfaim hine arso eres barzel halo hiv berabat bene amon tesha amot arkah vearba amot rakhbah beamat ish
veet haarets hazot yarashnu baet hahiv mearoer asher al nakhal arnon vakhatsi har hagilad vearav natati laruuveni velagadi
veyeter hagilad vekhal habashan mamlekhet og natati lakhatsi shevet hamnashe kol khevel haargov lekhal habashan hahu yikare erets refaim
yair ben menashe lakakh et kal khevel argov ad gevul hagshuri vehamaakhati vayikra otam al shemo et habashan khavot yair ad haom haze
ulmakhir natati et hagilad
velaruuveni velagadi natati min hagilad vead nakhal arnon tokh hanakhal ugvul vead yabok hanakhal gevul bene amon
vehaarava vehayarden ugvul mikineret vead yam haarava yam hamelakh takhat ashdot hapisga mizrakha
vaatsav etkhem baet hahiv lemor yehva elohekhem natan lakhem et haarets hazot lerishtah khalutsim taavru lifne akhekhem bene yisrael kal bene khayil
rak neshekhem vetapkhem umiknekhem yadati ki mikne rav lakhem yeshvu bearekhem asher natati lakhem
ad asher yaniakh yehva laakhekhem kakhem veyarshu gam hem et haarets asher yehva elohekhem noten lahem beever hayarden veshavtem ish lirushato asher natati lakhem
veet yehoshua tsiveti baet hahiv lemor enekha haroot et kal asher asa yehva elohekhem lishne hamlakhim haele ken yaase yehva lekhal hamamlakhot asher ata over shama

vaetkhanan el yehva baet hahiv lemor

veatem hadvekim bahva elohekhem khayim kulkhem haom
ree limadti etkhem khukim umishpatim kaasher tsivani yehva eloha laasot ken bekerev haarets asher atem baim shama lerishtah
ushmartem vaasitem ki hiv khakhmatkhem uvinatkhem leene haamim asher yishmun et kal hakhukim haele veamru rak am khakham venavon hago hagadol haze

rak hishamer lekha ushmor nafshkha meod pen tishkakh et hadvarim asher rau enekha ufen yasuru milvavkha kol yeme khayekha vehodatam levanekha velivne vanekha
yom asher amadta lifne yehva elohekha bekhorev beemor yehva ela hakhel li et haam veashmiem et devara asher yilmdun leyira oti kal hayamim asher hem khayim al haadama veet benehem yelamedun
vatikrvun vataamdun takhat hahar vehahar boer baesh ad lev hashamayim khoshekh anan vaarafel
vaydaber yehva alekhem mitokh haesh kol devarim atem shomim utmuna enkhem roim zulati kol
vayaged lakhem et berito asher tsiva etkhem laasot aseret hadvarim vayikhtvem al shene lukhot avanim
veoti tsiva yehva baet hahiv lelamed etkhem khukim umishpatim laasotkhem otam baarets asher atem ovrim shama lerishtah

vezakharta et yehva elohekha ki hu hanoten lekha koakh laasot khayil lemaan hakim et berito asher nishba laavotekha kaom haze
vehaya im shakhoakh tishkakh et yehva elohekha vehalakhta akhare elohim akherim vaavadtam vehishtakhavita lahem haidoti vakhem haom ki avod tovedun
kagoyim asher yehva maavid mipnekhem ken tovedun ekev lo tishmun bekol yehva elohekhem
shema yisrael ata over haom et hayarden lavo lareshet goyim gedolim vaatsumim mimeka arim gedolot uvtsurot bashamayim

veyadata haom ki yehva elohekha hu haover lefanekha esh okhla hu yashmidem vehu yakhniem lefanekha vehorashtam vehaavadtam maher kaasher diber yehva lakh

veyadata ki lo vetsidkatkha yehva elohekha noten lekha et haarets hatova hazot lerishtah ki am keshe oref ata
zekhor al tishkakh et asher hiktsafta et yehva elohekha bamidbar lemin haom asher yatsata meerets mitsrayim ad boakhem ad hamakom haze mamrim heyitem im yehva
uvkhorev hiktsaftem et yehva vayitanaf yehva bakhem lehashmid etkhem
baaloti hahara lakakhat lukhot haavanim lukhot habrit asher karat yehva imakhem vaeshev bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla lekhem lo akhalti umayim lo shatiti
vayiten yehva ela et shene lukhot haavanim ketuvim beetsba elohim vaalehem kekhal hadvarim asher diber yehva imakhem bahar mitokh haesh beom hakahal
vayhi mikets arbaim yom vearbaim layla natan yehva ela et shene lukhot haavanim lukhot habrit
vayomer yehva ela kum red maher mize ki shikhet amkha asher hotseta mimitsrayim saru maher min haderekh asher tsivitim asu lahem masekha
vayomer yehva ela lemor raiti et haam haze vehine am keshe oref hu
heref mimeni veashmidem veemkhe et shemam mitakhat hashamayim veeese otkha lego atsum varav mimenu
vaefen vaered min hahar vehahar boer baesh ushne lukhot habrit al shete yada
vaere vehine khatatem lahva elohekhem asitem lakhem egel masekha sartem maher min haderekh asher tsiva yehva etkhem

vaetnapal lifne yehva karishona arbaim yom vearbaim layla lekhem lo akhalti umayim lo shatiti al kal khatatkhem asher khatatem laasot hara beene yehva lehakhiso
ki yagorti mipne haaf vehakhema asher katsaf yehva alekhem lehashmid etkhem vayishma yehva ela gam bapaam hahiv
uvaharon hitanaf yehva meod lehashmido vaetpalel gam bead aharon baet hahiv
veet khatatkhem asher asitem et haegel lakakhti vaesrof oto baesh vaekot oto takhon hetev ad asher dak leafar vaashlikh et afaro el hanakhal hayored min hahar

vaetnapal lifne yehva et arbaim haom veet arbaim halayla asher hitnapalti ki amar yehva lehashmid etkhem

vayomer alehem mimeni tiru vekhen taasu vehine anokhi va biktse hamakhane vehaya khaasher eese ken taasun
vetakati bashofar anokhi vekhal asher iti utkatem bashofarot gam atem sevivot kal hamakhane vaamartem lahva ulgidon
vayavo gidon umea ish asher ito biktse hamakhane rosh haashmoret hatikhona akh hakem hekimu et hashomrim vayitku bashofarot venafots hakadim asher beyadam
vayitku sheloshet harashim bashofarot vayishbru hakadim vayakhaziku veyad semolam balapidim uvyad yeminam hashofarot litkoa vayikru kherev lahva ulgidon
vayaamdu ish takhtav saviv lamakhane vayarats kal hamakhane vayariu vnsv vayanusu
vayitku shelosh meot hashofarot vayasem yehva et kherev ish bereehu uvkhal hamakhane vayanas hamakhane ad bet hashita tsererata ad sefat avel mekhola al tabat
vayitsaek ish yisrael minaftali umin asher umin kal menashe vayirdfu akhare midyan
umalakhim shalakh gidon bekhal har efrayim lemor redu likrat midyan velikhdu lahem et hamayim ad bet bara veet hayarden vayitsaek kal ish efrayim vayilkdu et hamayim ad bet bara veet hayarden
vayilkdu shene sare midyan et orev veet zeev vayahargu et orev betsur orev veet zeev hargu veyekev zeev vayirdfu el midyan verosh orev uzev heviu el gidon meever layarden
vayomru elav ish efrayim ma hadavar haze asita lanu levilti kerovt lanu ki halakhta lehilakhem bemidyan vayrivun ito bekhazka

velo ekakh et kal hamamlakha miyado ki nasi ashitenu kol yeme khayav lemaan david avdi asher bakharti oto asher shamar mitsvota vekhukota
velakakhti hamlukha miyad beno untatia lekha et aseret hashvatim
velivno eten shevet ekhad lemaan heot nir ledavid avdi kal hayamim lefana birushaliam hair asher bakharti li lasum shemi sham
veotkha ekakh umalakhta bekhol asher teave nafshekha vehayita melekh al yisrael

vehaya im tishma et kal asher atsavekha vehalakhta vidrakha veasita hayashar beena lishmor khukota umitsvota kaasher asa david avdi vehayiti imakh uvaniti lekha vayit neeman kaasher baniti ledavid venatati lekha et yisrael
vaane et zera david lemaan zot akh lo khal hayamim
vayvakesh shelomo lehamit et yaravam vayakam yaravam vayivrakh mitsrayim el shishak melekh mitsrayim vayhi vemitsrayim ad mot shelomo
veyeter divre shelomo vekhal asher asa vekhakhmato halo hem ketuvim al sefer divre shelomo
vehayamim asher malakh shelomo virushaliam al kal yisrael arbaim shana
vayishkav shelomo im avotav vayikaver beir david aviv vayimlokh rekhavam beno takhtav
vayelekh rekhavam shekhem ki shekhem ba khal yisrael lehamlikh oto
vayhi kishmoa yaravam ben nevat vehu odenu vemitsrayim asher barakh mipne hamelekh shelomo vayeshev yaravam bemitsrayim
vayishlkhu vayikru lo vvv vayavo yaravam vekhal kehal yisrael vaydabru el rekhavam lemor
avikha hiksha et ulenu veata ata hakel meavodat avikha hakasha umeulo hakaved asher natan alenu venaavdeka
vayomer alehem lekhu od shelosha yamim veshuvu ela vayelkhu haam
vayivaats hamelekh rekhavam et hazkenim asher hau omdim et pene shelomo aviv bihyoto kha lemor ekh atem noatsim lehashiv et haam haze davar
vdvr vaydabru elav lemor im haom tihye eved laam haze vaavadtam vaanitam vedibarta alehem devarim tovim vehau lekha avadim kal hayamim
vayaazov et atsat hazkenim asher yeatsuhu vayivaats et hayladim asher gadlu ito asher haomdim lefanav
vayomer alehem ma atem noatsim venashiv davar et haam haze asher dibru ela lemor hakel min haol asher natan avikha alenu
vaydabru elav hayladim asher gadlu ito lemor ko tomar laam haze asher dibru elekha lemor avikha hikhbid et ulenu veata hakel mealenu ko tedaber alehem katani ava mimatne avi
veata avi hemis alekhem ol kaved vaani osif al ulkhem avi yisar etkhem bashotim vaani ayaser etkhem baakrabim
vvv vayavo yaravam vekhal haam el rekhavam baom hashlishi kaasher diber hamelekh lemor shuvu ela baom hashlishi
vayaan hamelekh et haam kasha vayaazov et atsat hazkenim asher yeatsuhu
vaydaber alehem kaatsat hayladim lemor avi hikhbid et ulkhem vaani osif al ulkhem avi yisar etkhem bashotim vaani ayaser etkhem baakrabim
velo shama hamelekh el haam ki hayta siba meim yehva lemaan hakim et devaro asher diber yehva beyad akhiya hashiloni el yaravam ben nevat
vayar kal yisrael ki lo shama hamelekh alehem vayashivu haam et hamelekh davar lemor ma lanu khelek bedavid velo nakhala beven yisha leohalekha yisrael ata ree vetkha david vayelekh yisrael leohalav
uvne yisrael hayoshvim beare yehuda vayimlokh alehem rekhavam
vayishlakh hamelekh rekhavam et adoram asher al hamas vayirgmu khal yisrael bo even vayamot vehamelekh rekhavam hitamets laalot bamerkava lanus yerushaliam
vayifshu yisrael bevet david ad haom haze
vayhi kishmoa kal yisrael ki shav yaravam vayishlkhu vayikru oto el haeda vayamlikhu oto al kal yisrael lo haya akhare vet david zulati shevet yehuda levado
vvv vayavo rekhavam yerushaliam vayakhel et kal bet yehuda veet shevet binyamin mea ushmonim elef bakhur ose milkhama lehilakhem im bet yisrael lehashiv et hamlukha lirkhavam ben shelomo
vayhi devar haelohim el shemaya ish haelohim lemor

ko amar yehva lo taalu velo tilakhamun im akhekhem bene yisrael shuvu ish leveto ki meiti nihya hadavar haze vayishmu et devar yehva vayashuvu lalekhet kidvar yehva
vayiven yaravam et shekhem behar efrayim vayeshev bah vayetse misham vayiven et penuel
vayomer yaravam belibo ata tashuv hamamlakha levet david
im yaale haam haze laasot zevakhim bevet yehva birushaliam veshav lev haam haze el adonehem el rekhavam melekh yehuda vaharaguni veshavu el rekhavam melekh yehuda
vayivaats hamelekh vayaas shene egle zahav vayomer alehem rav lakhem mealot yerushaliam hine elohekha yisrael asher heelukha meerets mitsrayim

vayhi hadavar haze lekhatat vayelkhu haam lifne haekhad ad dan
vayaas et bet bamot vayaas kohanim miktsot haam asher lo hau mibne levi

vayaal al hamizbeakh asher asa bevet el bakhamisha asar yom bakhodesh hashmini bakhodesh asher bada mlvd milibo vayaas khag livne yisrael vayaal al hamizbeakh lehaktir

vayikra al hamizbeakh bidvar yehva vayomer mizbeakh mizbeakh ko amar yehva hine ven nolad levet david yoshiyahu shemo vezavakh alekha et kohane habamot hamaktirim alekha veatsmot adam yisrfu alekha

vayomer ish haelohim el hamelekh im titen li et khatsi vetekha lo avo imakh velo okhal lekhem velo eshte mayim bamakom haze
ki khen tsiva oti bidvar yehva lemor lo tokhal lekhem velo tishte mayim velo tashuv baderekh asher halakhta
vayelekh bederekh akher velo shav baderekh asher ba vah el bet el
venavi ekhad zaken yoshev bevet el vayavo veno vaysaper lo et kal hamaase asher asa ish haelohim haom bevet el et hadvarim asher diber el hamelekh vaysaprum laavihem
vaydaber alehem avihem e ze haderekh halakh vayiru vanav et haderekh asher halakh ish haelohim asher ba mihuda

vayelekh akhare ish haelohim vayimtsaehu yoshev takhat haela vayomer elav haata ish haelohim asher bata mihuda vayomer ani

vayomer lo ukhal lashuv itakh velavo itakh velo okhal lekhem velo eshte itkha mayim bamakom haze

vayanakh et nivlato bekivro vayispdu alav ho akhi
vayhi akhare kavro oto vayomer el banav lemor bemoti ukvartem oti bakever asher ish haelohim kavur bo etsel atsmotav hanikhu et atsmota
ki hayo yihye hadavar asher kara bidvar yehva al hamizbeakh asher bevet el veal kal bate habamot asher beare shomron
akhar hadavar haze lo shav yaravam midarko haraa vayashav vayaas miktsot haam kohane vamot hekhafets yemale et yado vihi kohane vamot
vayhi badavar haze lekhatat bet yaravam ulhakhkhid ulhashmid meal pene haadama
baet hahi khala aviya ven yaravam
vayomer yaravam leishto kumi na vehishtanit velo yedu ki t at eshet yaravam vehalakht shilo hine sham akhiya hanavi hu diber ala lemelekh al haam haze
velakakhat beyadekh asara lekhem venikudim uvakbuk devash uvat elav hu yagid lakh ma yihye lanaar

vayomer akhad meavadav lo adoni hamelekh ki elisha hanavi asher beyisrael yagid lemelekh yisrael et hadvarim asher tedaber bakhadar mishkavekha
vayomer lekhu uru ekho hu veeshlakh veekakhehu vayugad lo lemor hine vedotan
vayishlakh shama susim verekhev vekhayil kaved vayavou layla vayakifu al hair
vayashkem mesharet ish haelohim lakum vayetse vehine khayil sovev et hair vesus varakhev vayomer naaro elav ahah adoni ekha naase
vayomer al tira ki rabim asher itanu measher otam
vayitpalel elisha vayomar yehva pekakh na et enav veyire vayifkakh yehva et ene hanaar vayar vehine hahar male susim verekhev esh sevivot elisha
vayerdu elav vayitpalel elisha el yehva vayomar hakh na et hago haze basanverim vayakem basanverim kidvar elisha
vayomer alehem elisha lo ze haderekh velo zo hair lekhu akhara veolikha etkhem el haish asher tevakeshun vayolekh otam shomrona
vayhi kevoam shomron vayomer elisha yehva pekakh et ene ele veyiru vayifkakh yehva et enehem vayiru vehine betokh shomron

vayhi akhare khen vayikbots ben hadad melekh aram et kal makhanehu vayaal vayatsar al shomron

vanvashel et beni vanokhlehu vaomar elea baom haakher teni et benekh venokhlenu vatakhbi et benah
vayhi khishmoa hamelekh et divre haisha vayikra et begadav vehu over al hakhoma vayar haam vehine hasak al besaro mibayit

vayhi kishmoa hamelekh khizkiyahu vayikra et begadav vayitkas basak vayavo bet yehva

ula yishma yehva elohekha et kal divre rav shake asher shelakho melekh ashur adonav lekharef elohim kha vehokhiakh badvarim asher shama yehva elohekha venasata tefila bead hasherit hanimtsaa

hinni noten bo ruakh veshama shemua veshav leartso vehipaltiv bakherev beartso

vayishma el tirhaka melekh kush lemor hine yatsa lehilakhem itakh vayashav vayishlakh malakhim el khizkiyahu lemor

hahitsilu otam elohe hagoyim asher shikhatu avota et gozan veet kharan veretsef uvne eden asher bitlasar
ao melekh khamat umelekh arpad umelekh lair sefarvayim hena veiva
vayikakh khizkiyahu et hasfarim miyad hamalakhim vayikraem vayaal bet yehva vayifrsehu khizkiyahu lifne yehva
vayitpalel khizkiyahu lifne yehva vayomar yehva elohe yisrael yoshev hakruvim ata hu haelohim levadkha lekhol mamlkhot haarets ata asita et hashamayim veet haarets
hate yehva aznkha ushama pekakh yehva enekha ure ushma et divre sankheriv asher shelakho lekharef elohim kha
amnam yehva hekherivu malkhe ashur et hagoyim veet artsam
venatnu et elohehem baesh ki lo elohim hema ki im maase yede adam ets vaeven vayabdum
veata yehva elohenu hoshienu na miyado veyedu kal mamlkhot haarets ki ata yehva elohim levadekha
vayishlakh yeshayahu ven amots el khizkiyahu lemor ko amar yehva elohe yisrael asher hitpalalta ela el sankheriv melekh ashur shamati
ze hadavar asher diber yehva alav baza lekha laaga lekha betulat bat tsion akharekha rosh henia bat yerushaliam
et mi kherafta vegidafta veal mi harimota kol vatisa marom enekha al kedosh yisrael
beyad malakhekha kherafta adona vatomer vrkhv berov rikhbi ani aliti merom harim yarkte levanon veekhrot komat arazav mivkhor beroshav veavoa melon kitso yaar karmilo
ani karti veshatiti mayim zarim veakhriv bekhaf peama kol yeore matsor
halo shamata lemerakhok otah asiti lemime kedem vitsartia ata havetia uthi lahshot galim nitsim arim betsurot
veyoshvehen kitsre yad khatu vayevoshu hau esev sade virak deshe khatsir gagot ushdefa lifne kama

veze lekha haot akhol hashana safiakh uvashana hashenit sakhish uvashana hashlishit ziru vekitsru venitu kheramim veikhlu firyam
veyasfa peletat bet yehuda hanishara shoresh lemata veasa feri lemala
ki mirushaliam tetse sheerit ufleta mehar tsion kinat yehva tsevaot taase zot
lakhen ko amar yehva el melekh ashur lo yavo el hair hazot velo yore sham khets velo yekadmena magen velo yishpokh alea solla
baderekh asher yavo bah yashuv veel hair hazot lo yavo neum yehva
veganoti el hair hazot lehoshiah lemaani ulmaan david avdi
vayhi balayla hahu vayetse malakh yehva vayakh bemakhane ashur mea shemonim vakhamisha alef vayashkimu vaboker vehine khulam pegarim metim
vayisa vayelekh vayashav sankheriv melekh ashur vayeshev beninve
vayhi hu mishtakhave bet nisrokh elohav veadramelekh vesaretser banav hikuhu vakherev vehema nimltu erets ararat vayimlokh esar khadon beno takhtav
bayamim hahem khala khizkiyahu lamut vayavo elav yeshayahu ven amots hanavi vayomer elav ko amar yehva tsav levetekha ki met ata velo tikhye
vayasev et panav el hakir vayitpalel el yehva lemor
ana yehva zekhar na et asher hithalakhti lefanekha beemet uvlevav shalem vehatov beenekha asiti vayevk khizkiyahu bekhi gadol
vayhi yeshayahu lo yatsa hr khatser hatikhona udvar yehva haya elav lemor
shuv veamarta el khizkiyahu negid ami ko amar yehva elohe david avikha shamati et tefilatekha raiti et dimatekha hinni rofe lakh baom hashlishi taale bet yehva
vehosafti al yamekha khamesh esre shana umikaf melekh ashur atsilkha veet hair hazot veganoti al hair hazot lemaani ulmaan david avdi
vayomer yeshayahu kekhu develet teenim vayikkhu vayasimu al hashkhin vayekhi

vayomer yekhizkiyahu nakel latsel lintot eser maalot lo khi yashuv hatsel akhoranit eser maalot

baet hahi shalakh berodakh baladan ben baladan melekh bavel sefarim uminkha el khizkiyahu ki shama ki khala khizkiyahu

vayishma alehem khizkiyahu vayarem et kal bet nekhoto et hakesef veet hazahav veet habsamim veet shemen hatov veet bet kelav veet kal asher nimtsa beotsrotav lo haya davar asher lo heram khizkiyahu beveto uvkhal memshalto
vayavo yeshayahu hanavi el hamelekh khizkiyahu vayomer elav ma amru haanashim haele umeayin yavou elekha vayomer khizkiyahu meerets rekhoka bau mibavel
vayomer ma rau bevetekha vayomer khizkiyahu et kal asher beveti rau lo haya davar asher lo hiritim beotsrota
vayomer yeshayahu el khizkiyahu shema devar yehva
hine yamim baim venisa kal asher bevetekha vaasher atsru avotekha ad haom haze bavela lo yivater davar amar yehva
umibanekha asher yetsu mimkha asher tolid ykkh yikakhu vehau sarisim behekhal melekh bavel
vayomer khizkiyahu el yeshayahu tov devar yehva asher dibarta vayomer halo im shalom veemet yihye veyama
veyeter divre khizkiyahu vekhal gevurato vaasher asa et habrekha veet hatala vayave et hamayim haira halo hem ketuvim al sefer divre hayamim lemalkhe yehuda

vayashav vayiven et habamot asher ibad khizkiyahu aviv vayakem mizbkhot labaal vayaas ashera kaasher asa akhav melekh yisrael vayishtakhu lekhal tseva hashamayim vayaavod otam
uvana mizbkhot bevet yehva asher amar yehva birushaliam asim et shemi
vayiven mizbkhot lekhal tseva hashamayim bishte khatsrot bet yehva
veheevir et beno baesh veonen venikhesh veasa ov veyidonim hirba laasot hara beene yehva lehakhis
vayasem et pesel haashera asher asa babayit asher amar yehva el david veel shelomo veno babayit haze uvirushaliam asher bakharti mikol shivte yisrael asim et shemi leolam
velo osif lehanid regel yisrael min haadama asher natati laavotam rak im yishmru laasot kekhol asher tsivitim ulkhal hatora asher tsiva otam avdi moshe
velo shameu vayatem menashe laasot et hara min hagoyim asher hishmid yehva mipne bene yisrael
vaydaber yehva beyad avadav hanviim lemor
yaan asher asa menashe melekh yehuda hatoevot haele hera mikol asher asu haemori asher lefanav vayakhati gam et yehuda begilulav

venatiti al yerushaliam et kav shomron veet mishkolet bet akhav umakhiti et yerushaliam kaasher yimkhe et hatsalakhat makha vehafakh al panea
venatashti et sheerit nakhalati untatim beyad oyvehem vehau levaz velimshisa lekhal oyvehem
yaan asher asu et hara beena vayihu makhisim oti min haom asher yatsu avotam mimitsrayim vead haom haze
vegam dam naki shafakh menashe harbe meod ad asher mile et yerushaliam pe lafe levad mekhatato asher hekheti et yehuda laasot hara beene yehva

vayaas lo tsidkiyahu ven kenaana karne varzel vayomer ko amar yehva beele tenagakh et aram ad kalotam
vekhal hanviim nibim ken lemor ale ramot gilad vehatslakh venatan yehva beyad hamelekh
vehamalakh asher halakh likro lemikhayhu diber elav lemor hine divre hanviim pe ekhad tov el hamelekh vihi na devarkha keakhad mehem vedibarta tov
vayomer mikhayhu kha yehva ki et asher yomar eloha oto adaber
vayavo el hamelekh vayomer hamelekh elav mikha hanelekh el ramot gilad lamilkhama im ekhdal vayomer alu vehatslikhu veyinatnu beyedkhem
vayomer elav hamelekh ad kame feamim ani mashbiekha asher lo tedaber ela rak emet beshem yehva
vayomer raiti et kal yisrael nefotsim al heharim katson asher en lahen roe vayomer yehva lo adonim laele yashuvu ish leveto beshalom
vayomer melekh yisrael el yehoshafat halo amarti elekha lo yitnabe ala tov ki im lera
vayomer lakhen shimu devar yehva raiti et yehva yoshev al kiso vekhal tseva hashamayim omdim al yemino usmolo
vayomer yehva mi yefate et akhav melekh yisrael veyaal veyipol beramot gilad vayomer ze omer kakha veze omer kakha
vayetse haruakh vayaamod lifne yehva vayomer ani afatenu vayomer yehva elav bama
vayomer etse vehayiti leruakh sheker befi kal neviav vayomer tefate vegam tukhal tse vaase khen
veata hine natan yehva ruakh sheker befi neviekha ele vahva diber alekha raa
vayigash tsidkiyahu ven kenaana vayakh et mikhayhu al halekhi vayomer e ze haderekh avar ruakh yehva meiti ledaber otakh
vayomer mikhayhu hinkha roe baom hahu asher tavo kheder bekheder lehekhave
vayomer melekh yisrael kekhu et mikhayhu vahashivuhu el amon sar hair veel yoash ben hamelekh
vaamartem ko amar hamelekh simu ze bet hakele vehaakhiluhu lekhem lakhats umayim lakhats ad shuvi veshalom
vayomer mikhayhu im shov tashuv beshalom lo diber yehva bi vayomer shimu amim kulam
vayaal melekh yisrael vihoshafat melekh yehuda el ramot gilad
vayomer melekh yisrael el yehoshafat hitkhapes vavo vamilkhama veata levash begadekha vayitkhapes melekh yisrael vayavou bamilkhama
umelekh aram tsiva et sare harekhev asher lo lemor lo tilakhamu et hakaton et hagadol ki im et melekh yisrael levado
vayhi kirot sare harekhev et yehoshafat vehema amru melekh yisrael hu vayasobu alav lehilakhem vayizak yehoshafat vahva azaro vaysitem elohim mimenu
vayhi kirot sare harekhev ki lo haya melekh yisrael vayashuvu meakharav
veish mashakh bakeshet letumo vayakh et melekh yisrael ben hadvakim uven hashiryan vayomer larakav hafokh ydkh yadkha vehotsetani min hamakhane ki hakholeti
vataal hamilkhama baom hahu umelekh yisrael haya maamid bamerkava nokhakh aram ad haarev vayamat leet bo hashamesh
vayashav yehoshafat melekh yehuda el beto beshalom lirushaliam
vayetse el panav yehu ven khanani hakhoze vayomer el hamelekh yehoshafat halarasha lazor ulsone yehva teehav uvazot alekha ketsef milifne yehva
aval devarim tovim nimtsu imakh ki viarta haasherot min haarets vahakhinota levavkha lidrosh haelohim
vayeshev yehoshafat birushaliam vayashav vayetse vaam miber sheva ad har efrayim vayshivem el yehva elohe avotehem
vayaamed shoftim baarets bekhal are yehuda habtsurot leir vair
vayomer el hashoftim reu ma atem osim ki lo leadam tishptu ki lahva veimakhem bidvar mishpat
veata yehi fakhad yehva alekhem shimru vaasu ki en im yehva elohenu avla umaso fanim umikakh shokhad
vegam birushaliam heemid yehoshafat min halviyim vehakohanim umerashe haavot leyisrael lemishpat yehva velariv vayashuvu yerushaliam
vaytsav alehem lemor ko taasun beyirat yehva beemuna uvlevav shalem

vekhal riv asher yavo alekhem meakhekhem hayoshvim bearehem ben dam ledam ben tora lemitsva lekhukim ulmishpatim vehizhartem otam velo yeshmu lahva vehaya ketsef alekhem veal akhekhem ko taasun velo teshamu
vehine amaryahu khohen harosh alekhem lekhol devar yehva uzvadyahu ven yishmael hanagid levet yehuda lekhol devar hamelekh veshotrim halviyim lifnekhem khizku vaasu vihi yehva im hatov
vayhi akhare khen bau vene moav uvne amon veimahem mehaamonim al yehoshafat lamilkhama
vayavou vayagidu lihoshafat lemor ba alekha hamon rav meever layam mearam vehinam bekhatstson tamar hi en gedi
vayira vayiten yehoshafat et panav lidrosh lahva vayikra tsom al kal yehuda
vayikavtsu yehuda levakesh meyhva gam mikal are yehuda bau levakesh et yehva
vayaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushaliam bevet yehva lifne hekhatser hakhadasha
vayomar yehva elohe avotenu halo ata hu elohim bashamayim veata moshel bekhol mamlkhot hagoyim uvyadkha koakh ugvura veen imkha lehityatsev
halo ata elohenu horashta et yoshve haarets hazot milifne amkha yisrael vatitnah lezera avraham ohavkha leolam
vayeshvu vah vayivnu lekha bah mikdash leshimkha lemor
im tavo alenu raa kherev shefot vedever veraav naamda lifne habayit haze ulfanekha ki shimkha babayit haze venizak elekha mitsaratenu vetishma vetoshia
veata hine vene amon umoav vehar seir asher lo natata leyisrael lavo vahem bevoam meerets mitsrayim ki saru mealehem velo hishmidum
vehine hem gomlim alenu lavo legarshenu miyrushatkha asher horashtanu
elohenu halo tishpat bam ki en banu koakh lifne hehamon harav haze haba alenu vaanakhnu lo neda ma naase ki alekha enenu
vekhal yehuda omdim lifne yehva gam tapam neshehem uvnehem
veyakhaziel ben zekharyahu ben benaya ben yeiel ben matanya halevi min bene asaf hayta alav ruakh yehva betokh hakahal
vayomer hakshivu khal yehuda veyoshve yerushaliam vehamelekh yehoshafat ko amar yehva lakhem atem al tiru veal tekhatu mipne hehamon harav haze ki lo lakhem hamilkhama ki lelohim
makhar redu alehem hinam olim bemaale hatsits umtsatem otam besof hanakhal pene midbar yeruel
lo lakhem lehilakhem bazot hityatsvu imdu uru et yeshuat yehva imakhem yehuda virushaliam al tiru veal tekhatu makhar tseu lifnehem vahva imakhem
vayikod yehoshafat apayim artsa vekhal yehuda veyoshve yerushaliam naflu lifne yehva lehishtakhavot lahva
vayakumu halviyim min bene hakhatim umin bene hakarkhim lehalel lahva elohe yisrael bekol gadol lemala
vayashkimu vaboker vayetsu lemidbar tekoa uvtsetam amad yehoshafat vayomer shemauni yehuda veyoshve yerushaliam haaminu bahva elohekhem veteamenu haaminu vinviav vehatslikhu
vayivaats el haam vayaamed meshorarim lahva umhallim lehadrat kodesh betset lifne hekhaluts veomrim hodu lahva ki leolam khasdo
uvet hekhelu verina uthila natan yehva mearvim al bene amon moav vehar seir habaim lihuda vayinagefu
vayaamdu bene amon umoav al yoshve har seir lehakharim ulhashmid ukhkhalotam beoshve seir azru ish bereehu lemashkhit
vihuda ba al hamitspe lamidbar vayifnu el hehamon vehinam pegarim noflim artsa veen peleta
vayavo yehoshafat veamo lavoz et shelalam vayimtsu vahem larov urkhush ufgarim ukhle khamudot vaynatslu lahem leen masa vayihu yamim shelosha bozzim et hashalal ki rav hu
uvaom harvii nikhalu leemek berakha ki sham berakhu et yehva al ken karu et shem hamakom hahu emek berakha ad haom
vayashuvu kal ish yehuda virushaliam vihoshafat berosham lashuv el yerushaliam besimkha ki simkham yehva meoyvehem
vayavou yerushaliam binvalim uvkhinorot uvakhatsotsrot el bet yehva
vayhi pakhad elohim al kal mamlkhot haaratsot beshamam ki nilkham yehva im oyve yisrael
vatishkot malkhut yehoshafat vayanakh lo elohav misaviv
vayimlokh yehoshafat al yehuda ben sheloshim vekhamesh shana bemalkho veesrim vekhamesh shana malakh birushaliam veshem imo azuva bat shilkhi
vayelekh bederekh aviv asa velo sar mimena laasot hayashar beene yehva
akh habamot lo saru veod haam lo hekhinu levavam lelohe avotehem
veyeter divre yehoshafat harishonim vehaakharonim hinam ketuvim bedivre yehu ven khanani asher hoala al sefer malkhe yisrael
veakhare khen etkhabar yehoshafat melekh yehuda im akhazya melekh yisrael hu hirshia laasot
vaykhabrehu imo laasot oniot lalekhet tarshish vayaasu oniot beetson gaver
vayitnabe eliezer ben dodavahu mimaresha al yehoshafat lemor kehitkhaberkha im akhazyahu parats yehva et maasekha vayishavru oniot velo atsru lalekhet el tarshish
vayishkav yehoshafat im avotav vayikaver im avotav beir david vayimlokh yehoram beno takhtav
velo akhim bene yehoshafat azarya vikhiel uzkharyahu vaazaryahu umikhael ushfatyahu kal ele bene yehoshafat melekh yisrael
vayiten lahem avihem matanot rabot lekhesef ulzahav ulmigdanot im are metsurot bihuda veet hamamlakha natan lihoram ki hu habkhor
vayakam yehoram al mamlekhat aviv vayitkhazak vayaharog et kal ekhav bekharev vegam misare yisrael
ben sheloshim ushtayim shana yehoram bemalkho ushmone shanim malakh birushaliam
vayelekh bederekh malkhe yisrael kaasher asu bet akhav ki bat akhav hayta lo isha vayaas hara beene yehva
velo ava yehva lehashkhit et bet david lemaan habrit asher karat ledavid vekhaasher amar latet lo nir ulvanav kal hayamim
beyamav pasha edom mitakhat yad yehuda vayamlikhu alehem melekh
vayaavor yehoram im sarav vekhal harekhev imo vayhi kam layla vayakh et edom hasovev elav veet sare harakhev
vayifsha edom mitakhat yad yehuda ad haom haze az tifsha livna baet hahi mitakhat yado ki azav et yehva elohe avotav
gam hu asa vamot behare yehuda vayezen et yoshve yerushaliam vayadakh et yehuda
vayavo elav mikhtav meeliyahu hanavi lemor ko amar yehva elohe david avikha takhat asher lo halakhta bedarkhe yehoshafat avikha uvdarkhe asa melekh yehuda
vatelekh bederekh malkhe yisrael vatazne et yehuda veet yoshve yerushaliam kehaznot bet akhav vegam et akhekha vet avikha hatovim mimkha haragta
hine yehva nogef magefa gedola beamekha uvvanekha uvnashekha uvkhal rekhushekha
veata bakholayim rabim bemakhale meekha ad yetsu meekha min hakholi yamim al yamim
vayaar yehva al yehoram et ruakh haplishtim vehaarvim asher al yad kushim
vayaalu vihuda vayivkaua vayishbu et kal harkhush hanimtsa levet hamelekh vegam banav venashav velo nishar lo ben ki im yehoakhaz keton banav
veakhare kal zot negafo yehva bemeav lakholi leen marpe
vayhi leyamim miyamim ukhet tset hakets leyamim shenayim yatsu meav im khalo vayamat betakhaluim raim velo asu lo amo serefa kisrefat avotav
ben sheloshim ushtayim haya vemalkho ushmone shanim malakh birushaliam vayelekh belo khemda vayikbruhu beir david velo bekivrot hamlakhim
vayamlikhu yoshve yerushaliam et akhazyahu veno hakaton takhtav ki khal harishonim harag hagdud haba vaarvim lamakhane vayimlokh akhazyahu ven yehoram melekh yehuda
ben arbaim ushtayim shana akhazyahu vemalkho veshana akhat malakh birushaliam veshem imo atalyahu bat amri
gam hu halakh bedarkhe bet akhav ki imo hayta yoatsto leharshia
vayaas hara beene yehva kevet akhav ki hema hau lo yoatsim akhare mot aviv lemashkhit lo
gam baatsatam halakh vayelekh et yehoram ben akhav melekh yisrael lamilkhama al khazael melekh aram beramot gilad vayaku haramim et yoram
vayashav lehitrape veyizrel ki hamakim asher hikuhu varama behilakhamo et khazahel melekh aram vaazaryahu ven yehoram melekh yehuda yarad lirot et yehoram ben akhav beyizrel ki khole hu
umeelohim hayta tevusat akhazyahu lavo el yoram uvvoo yatsa im yehoram el yehu ven nimshi asher meshakho yehva lehakhrit et bet akhav
vayhi kehishafet yehu im bet akhav vayimtsa et sare yehuda uvne akhe akhazyahu meshartim laakhazyahu vayahargem

vayvakesh et akhazyahu vayilkduhu vehu mitkhabe veshomron vayviuhu el yehu vaymituhu vayikbruhu ki amru ben yehoshafat hu asher darash et yehva bekhal levavo veen levet akhazyahu latsor koakh lemamlakha
vaatalyahu em akhazyahu raata ki met benah vatakam vatdaber et kal zera hamamlakha levet yehuda

vatikakh yehoshavat bat hamelekh et yoash ben akhazyahu vatignov oto mitokh bene hamelekh hamumatim vatiten oto veet menikto bakhadar hamitot vatastirehu yehoshavat bat hamelekh yehoram eshet yehoyada hakohen ki hi hayta akhot akhazyahu mipne atalyahu velo hemitathu
vayhi itam bevet haelohim mitkhabe shesh shanim vaatalya molekhet al haarets
uvashana hashviit hitkhazak yehoyada vayikakh et sare hameot laazaryahu ven yerokham ulyishmael ben yehokhanan velaazaryahu ven oved veet maaseyahu ven adayahu veet elishafat ben zikhri imo vabrit
vayasobu bihuda vayikbtsu et halviyim mikal are yehuda verashe haavot leyisrael vayavou el yerushaliam
vayikhrot kal hakahal berit bevet haelohim im hamelekh vayomer lahem hine ven hamelekh yimlokh kaasher diber yehva al bene david
ze hadavar asher taasu hashlishit mikem bae hashabat lakohanim velalviyim leshoare hasipim
vehashlishit bevet hamelekh vehashlishit beshaar haysod vekhal haam bekhatsrot bet yehva
veal yavo vet yehva ki im hakohanim vehamshartim lalviyim hema yavou ki kodesh hema vekhal haam yishmru mishmeret yehva
vehikifu halviyim et hamelekh saviv ish vekhelav beyado vehaba el habayit yumat vihu et hamelekh bevoo uvtseto
vayaasu halviyim vekhal yehuda kekhol asher tsiva yehoyada hakohen vayikkhu ish et anashav bae hashabat im yotse hashabat ki lo fatar yehoyada hakohen et hamakhlkot
vayiten yehoyada hakohen lesare hameot et hakhanitim veet hamaginot veet hashlatim asher lamelekh david asher bet haelohim
vayaamed et kal haam veish shilkho veyado miketef habayit haymanit ad ketef habayit hasmalit lamizbeakh velabayit al hamelekh saviv
vaotsiu et ben hamelekh vayitnu alav et hanezer veet haedut vayamlikhu oto vayimshakhuhu yehoyada uvanav vayomru yekhi hamelekh
vatishma atalyahu et kol haam haratsim vehamhallim et hamelekh vatavo el haam bet yehva

vatere vehine hamelekh omed al amudo bamavo vehasarim vehakhatsotsrot al hamelekh vekhal am haarets sameakh vetokea bakhatsotsrot vehamshorarim bikhle hashir umodiim lehalel vatikra atalyahu et begadea vatomer kesher kasher
vaotse yehoyada hakohen et sare hameot pekude hakhayil vayomer alehem hotsiua el mibet hasderot vehaba akharea yumat bekharev ki amar hakohen lo temitua bet yehva
vayasimu lah yadayim vatavo el mevo shaar hasusim bet hamelekh vaymitua sham
vayikhrot yehoyada berit beno uven kal haam uven hamelekh lihot leam lahva
vayavou khal haam bet habaal vayittsuhu veet mizbkhotav veet tselamav shiberu veet matan kohen habaal hargu lifne hamizbkhot
vayasem yehoyada pekudot bet yehva beyad hakohanim halviyim asher khalak david al bet yehva lehaalot olot yehva kakatuv betorat moshe besimkha uvshir al yede david
vayaamed hashoarim al shaare bet yehva velo yavo tame lekhal davar
vayikakh et sare hameot veet haadirim veet hamoshlim baam veet kal am haarets vaored et hamelekh mibet yehva vayavou betokh shaar haelon bet hamelekh vaoshivu et hamelekh al kise hamamlakha
vayismkhu khal am haarets vehair shakata veet atalyahu hemitu vekharev
ben sheva shanim yoash bemalkho vearbaim shana malakh birushaliam veshem imo tsivya miber shava
vayaas yoash hayashar beene yehva kal yeme yehoyada hakohen
vayisa lo yehoyada nashim shetayim vaoled banim uvanot
vayhi akhare khen haya im lev yoash lekhadesh et bet yehva
vayikbots et hakohanim vehalviyim vayomer lahem tseu leare yehuda vekivtsu mikal yisrael kesef lekhazek et bet elohekhem mide shana beshana veatem temaharu ladavar velo miharu halviyim
vayikra hamelekh lihoyada harosh vayomer lo madua lo darashta al halviyim lehavi mihuda umirushaliam et masat moshe eved yehva vehakahal leyisrael leohel haedut
ki atalyahu hamirshaat banea fartsu et bet haelohim vegam kal kadshe vet yehva asu labalim
vayomer hamelekh vayaasu aron ekhad vayitnuhu beshaar bet yehva khutsa
vayitnu kol bihuda uvirushaliam lehavi lahva masat moshe eved haelohim al yisrael bamidbar
vayismkhu khal hasarim vekhal haam vayaviu vayashlikhu laaron ad lekhale

vayhi beet yavi et haaron el pekudat hamelekh beyad halviyim vekhirotam ki rav hakesef uva sofer hamelekh ufkid kohen harosh viaru et haaron veyisauhu vishivuhu el mekomo ko asu leom beom vayaasfu khesef larov
vayitnehu hamelekh vihoyada el ose melekhet avodat bet yehva vayihu sokhrim khotsvim vekharashim lekhadesh bet yehva vegam lekharashe varzel unkhoshet lekhazek et bet yehva
vayaasu ose hamlakha vataal arukha lamlakha beyadam vayaamidu et bet haelohim al matkunto vayamtsuhu
ukhkhalotam heviu lifne hamelekh vihoyada et shear hakesef vayaasehu khelim levet yehva kele sharet vehaalot vekhapot ukhle zahav vakhasef vayihu maalim olot bevet yehva tamid kol yeme yehoyada
vayizkan yehoyada vayisba yamim vayamot ben mea ushloshim shana bemoto
vayikbruhu veir david im hamlakhim ki asa tova beyisrael veim haelohim uveto
veakhare mot yehoyada bau sare yehuda vayishtakhavu lamelekh az shama hamelekh alehem
vayaazvu et bet yehva elohe avotehem vayaavdu et haasherim veet haatsabim vayhi ketsef al yehuda virushaliam beashmatam zot
vayishlakh bahem neviim lahashivam el yehva vayaidu vam velo heezinu
veruakh elohim lavsha et zekharya ben yehoyada hakohen vayaamod meal laam vayomer lahem ko amar haelohim lama atem ovrim et mitsvot yehva velo tatslikhu ki azavtem et yehva vayaazov etkhem
vayikshru alav vayirgmuhu even bemitsvat hamelekh bakhatsar bet yehva
velo zakhar yoash hamelekh hakhesed asher asa yehoyada aviv imo vayaharog et beno ukhmoto amar yere yehva veyidrosh
vayhi litkufat hashana ala alav khel aram vayavou el yehuda virushaliam vayashkhitu et kal sare haam meam vekhal shelalam shilkhu lemelekh darmasek
ki vemitsar anashim bau khel aram vahva natan beyadam khayil larov meod ki azvu et yehva elohe avotehem veet yoash asu shefatim
uvlekhtam mimenu ki azvu oto vmkhlm bemakhaluyim rabim hitkashru alav avadav bidme bene yehoyada hakohen vayaharguhu al mitato vayamot vayikbruhu beir david velo kevaruhu bekivrot hamlakhim
veele hamitkashrim alav zavad ben shimat haamonit vihozavad ben shimrit hamoavit
uvanav vrv yirev hamasa alav visod bet haelohim hinam ketuvim al midrash sefer hamlakhim vayimlokh amatsyahu veno takhtav
ben esrim vekhamesh shana malakh amatsyahu veesrim vatesha shana malakh birushaliam veshem imo yehoadan mirushalayim
vayaas hayashar beene yehva rak lo belevav shalem
vayhi kaasher khazka hamamlakha alav vayaharog et avadav hamakim et hamelekh aviv
veet benehem lo hemit ki khakatuv batora besefer moshe asher tsiva yehva lemor lo yamutu avot al banim uvanim lo yamutu al avot ki ish bekheto yamutu

vayikbots amatsyahu et yehuda vayaamidem levet avot lesare haalafim ulsare hameot lekhal yehuda uvinyamin vayifkdem lemiben esrim shana vamala vayimtsaem shelosh meot elef bakhur yotse tsava okhez romakh vetsina
vayiskor miyisrael mea elef gibor khayil bemea khikar kasef
veish haelohim ba elav lemor hamelekh al yavo imkha tseva yisrael ki en yehva im yisrael kol bene efrayim
ki im bo ata ase khazak lamilkhama yakhshilkha haelohim lifne oyev ki yesh koakh belohim lazor ulhakhshil
vayomer amatsyahu leish haelohim uma laasot limat hakikar asher natati ligdud yisrael vayomer ish haelohim yesh lahva latet lekha harbe mize
vayavdilem amatsyahu lehagdud asher ba elav meefrayim lalekhet limkomam vayikhar apam meod bihuda vayashuvu limkomam bakhori af
vaamatsyahu hitkhazak vayinhag et amo vayelekh ge hamelakh vayakh et bene seir aseret alafim
vaaseret alafim khayim shavu bene yehuda vayvium lerosh hasala vayashlikhum merosh hasela vekhulam nivkau
uvne hagdud asher heshiv amatsyahu milekhet imo lamilkhama vayifshtu beare yehuda mishomron vead bet khoron vayaku mehem sheloshet alafim vayavozu biza raba
vayhi akhare vo amatsyahu mehakot et adomim vayave et elohe bene seir vayaamidem lo lelohim velifnehem yishtakhave velahem yekater
vayikhar af yehva baamatsyahu vayishlakh elav navi vayomer lo lama darashta et elohe haam asher lo hitsilu et amam miyadekha
vayhi bedabro elav vayomer lo haloets lamelekh netanukha khadal lekha lama yakukha vayekhdal hanavi vayomer yadati ki yaats elohim lehashkhitekha ki asita zot velo shamata laatsati
vayivaats amatsyahu melekh yehuda vayishlakh el yoash ben yehoakhaz ben yehu melekh yisrael lemor lkh lekha nitrae fanim

vayishlakh yoash melekh yisrael el amatsyahu melekh yehuda lemor hakhoakh asher balvanon shalakh el haerez asher balvanon lemor tena et bitkha livni leisha vataavor khayat hasade asher balvanon vatirmos et hakhoakh

vaeten lifne bene vet harekhavim geviim meleim yayin vekhosot vaomar alehem shetu yayin
vayomru lo nishte yayin ki yonadav ben rekhav avinu tsiva alenu lemor lo tishtu yayin atem uvnekhem ad olam
uvayit lo tivnu vezera lo tizrau vekherem lo titau velo yihye lakhem ki baohalim teshvu kal yemekhem lemaan tikhu yamim rabim al pene haadama asher atem garim sham

hukam et divre yehonadav ben rekhav asher tsiva et banav levilti shetot yayin velo shatu ad haom haze ki shamu et mitsvat avihem veanokhi dibarti alekhem hashkem vedaber velo shematem ela

vayhi bashana harviit lihoyakim ben yoshiyahu melekh yehuda haya hadavar haze el yirmyahu meet yehva lemor

vayered bet hamelekh al lishkat hasofer vehine sham kal hasarim yoshvim elishama hasofer udlayahu ven shemayahu veelnatan ben akhbor ugmaryahu ven shafan vetsidkiyahu ven khananyahu vekhal hasarim
vayaged lahem mikhayhu et kal hadvarim asher shamea bikro varukh basefer beazne haam

vayishlkhu khal hasarim el barukh et yehudi ben netanyahu ben shelemyahu ven kushi lemor hamgila asher karata bah beazne haam kakhena veyadkha valekh vayikakh barukh ben neriyahu et hamgila beyado vayavo alehem
vayomru elav shev na ukraena beaznenu vayikra varukh beaznehem
vayhi keshamam et kal hadvarim pakhadu ish el reehu vayomru el barukh haged nagid lamelekh et kal hadvarim haele
veet barukh shaalu lemor haged na lanu ekh katavta et kal hadvarim haele mipiv
vayomer lahem barukh mipiv yikra ela et kal hadvarim haele vaani kotev al hasefer bado
vayomru hasarim el barukh lekh hisater ata veyirmyahu veish al yeda efo atem
vayavou el hamelekh khatsera veet hamgila hifkidu belishkat elishama hasofer vayagidu beazne hamelekh et kal hadvarim
vayishlakh hamelekh et yehudi lakakhat et hamgila vayikakhea milishkat elishama hasofer vayikraea yehudi beazne hamelekh uvazne kal hasarim haomdim meal hamelekh

vayhi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa yikraea betaar hasofer vehashlekh el haesh asher el haakh ad tom kal hamgila al haesh asher al haakh
velo fakhadu velo karu et bigdehem hamelekh vekhal avadav hashomim et kal hadvarim haele
vegam elnatan udlayahu ugmaryahu hifgiu vamelekh levilti serof et hamgila velo shama alehem
vaytsave hamelekh et yerakhmel ben hamelekh veet serayahu ven azriel veet shelemyahu ben avdel lakakhat et barukh hasofer veet yirmyahu hanavi vayastirem yehva
vayhi devar yehva el yirmyahu akhare serof hamelekh et hamgila veet hadvarim asher katav barukh mipi yirmyahu lemor
shuv kakh lekha megila akheret ukhtov alea et kal hadvarim harishonim asher hau al hamgila harishona asher saraf yehoyakim melekh yehuda
veal yehoyakim melekh yehuda tomar ko amar yehva ata sarafta et hamgila hazot lemor madua katavta alea lemor bo yavo melekh bavel vehishkhit et haarets hazot vehishbit mimena adam uvhema
lakhen ko amar yehva al yehoyakim melekh yehuda lo yihye lo yoshev al kise david venivlato tihye mushlekhet lakhorev baom velakerakh balayla
ufakadti alav veal zaro veal avadav et avonam veheveti alehem veal yoshve yerushaliam veel ish yehuda et kal haraa asher dibarti alehem velo shameu

vayimlakh melekh tsidkiyahu ben yoshiyahu takhat kanyahu ben yehoyakim asher himlikh nevukhadretsar melekh bavel beerets yehuda
velo shama hu vaavadav veam haarets el divre yehva asher diber beyad yirmyahu hanavi
vayishlakh hamelekh tsidkiyahu et yehukhal ben shelemya veet tsefanyahu ven maaseya hakohen el yirmyahu hanavi lemor hitpalel na vaadenu el yehva elohenu
veyirmyahu ba veyotse betokh haam velo natnu oto bet hkhl haklu
vekhel paro yatsa mimitsrayim vayishmu hakasdim hatsarim al yerushaliam et shimam vayealu meal yerushaliam
vayhi devar yehva el yirmyahu hanavi lemor
ko amar yehva elohe yisrael ko tomru el melekh yehuda hasholeakh etkhem ela ledarsheni hine khel paro hayotse lakhem leezra shav leartso mitsrayim
veshavu hakasdim venilkhamu al hair hazot ulkhadua usrafua vaesh
ko amar yehva al tashiu nafshotekhem lemor halokh yelkhu mealenu hakasdim ki lo yelekhu
ki im hikitem kal khel kasdim hanilkhamim itkhem venisharu vam anashim medukarim ish beaholo yakumu vesarfu et hair hazot baesh
vehaya behealot khel hakasdim meal yerushaliam mipne khel paro
vayetse yirmyahu mirushaliam lalekhet erets binyamin lakhalik misham betokh haam
vayhi hu beshaar binyamin vesham baal pekidut ushmo yiriya ben shelemya ben khananya vayitpos et yirmyahu hanavi lemor el hakasdim ata nofel
vayomer yirmyahu sheker eneni nofel al hakasdim velo shama elav vayitpos yiriya beyirmyahu vayviehu el hasarim
vayiktsfu hasarim al yirmyahu vehiku oto venatnu oto bet haesur bet yehonatan hasofer ki oto asu levet hakele
ki va yirmyahu el bet habor veel hakhanuot vayeshev sham yirmyahu yamim rabim
vayishlakh hamelekh tsidkiyahu vayikakhehu vayishalehu hamelekh beveto baseter vayomer hayesh davar meet yehva vayomer yirmyahu yesh vayomer beyad melekh bavel tinaten
vayomer yirmyahu el hamelekh tsidkiyahu me khatati lekha velaavadekha velaam haze ki netatem oti el bet hakele

veata shema na adoni hamelekh tipal na tekhinati lefanekha veal teshiveni bet yehonatan hasofer velo amut sham
vaytsave hamelekh tsidkiyahu vayafkidu et yirmyahu bakhatsar hamatara venaton lo khikar lekhem laom mikhuts haofim ad tom kal halekhem min hair vayeshev yirmyahu bakhatsar hamatara
vayishma shefatya ven matan ugdalyahu ben pashkhur veukhal ben shelemyahu ufashkhur ben malkiya et hadvarim asher yirmyahu medaber el kal haam lemor

ko amar yehva hinaton tinaten hair hazot beyad khel melekh bavel ulkhadah

vayishma eved melekh hakushi ish saris vehu bevet hamelekh ki natnu et yirmyahu el habor vehamelekh yoshev beshaar binyamin

vayomer eved melekh hakushi el yirmyahu sim na beloe haskhavot vehamlakhim takhat atsilot yadekha mitakhat lakhavalim vayaas yirmyahu ken

vekhi yishmu hasarim ki dibarti itakh uvau elekha veamru elekha hagida na lanu ma dibarta el hamelekh al tekhakhed mimenu velo nemitekha uma diber elekha hamelekh

vayeshev yirmyahu bakhatsar hamatara ad yom asher nilkda yerushaliam vehaya kaasher nilkda yerushaliam
bashana hatshiit letsidkiyahu melekh yehuda bakhodesh haasiri ba nevukhadretsar melekh bavel vekhal khelo el yerushaliam vayatsuru alea
beashte esre shana letsidkiyahu bakhodesh harvii betisha lakhodesh havka hair
vayavou kol sare melekh bavel vayeshvu beshaar hatavekh nergal sar etser samgar nevu sar sekhim rav saris nergal sar etser rav mag vekhal sheerit sare melekh bavel
vayhi kaasher raam tsidkiyahu melekh yehuda vekhol anshe hamilkhama vayivrkhu vayetsu layla min hair derekh gan hamelekh beshaar ben hakhomotayim vayetse derekh haarava
vayirdfu khel kasdim akharehem vayasigu et tsidkiyahu bearvot yerekho vayikkhu oto vayaaluhu el nevukhadretsar melekh bavel rivlata beerets khamat vaydaber ito mishpatim
vayishkhat melekh bavel et bene tsidkiyahu berivla leenav veet kal khore yehuda shakhat melekh bavel
veet ene tsidkiyahu iver vayaasrehu bankhushtayim lavi oto bavela
veet bet hamelekh veet bet haam sarfu hakasdim baesh veet khomot yerushaliam natatsu
veet yeter haam hanisharim bair veet hanoflim asher naflu alav veet yeter haam hanisharim hegla nevuzar adan rav tabakhim bavel

vaytsav nevukhadretsar melekh bavel al yirmyahu beyad nevuzaradan rav tabakhim lemor

vayishlakh nevuzaradan rav tabakhim unvushazban rav saris venergal sar etser rav mag vekhol rabe melekh bavel

vayikakh rav tabakhim leyirmyahu vayomer elav yehva elohekha diber et haraa hazot el hamakom haze
vayave vayaas yehva kaasher diber ki khatatem lahva velo shematem bekolo vehaya lakhem dvr hadavar haze

vayishava lahem gedalyahu ven akhikam ben shafan ulanshehem lemor al tiru meavod hakasdim shevu vaarets veivdu et melekh bavel veyitav lakhem
